findings.title: Nobody reads Node 3.1
findings.message: Node 0.1 sends to Node 3.1, but nothing consumes it: messages pile up.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads Node 3.1, then add it and connect n3-1 to it.

findings.title: Node 2.2 has no dead-letter queue
findings.message: If Node 3.2 can't handle a message, it's dropped after 3 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
